      --bg-bottom: #d9f1ef;
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --surface-strong: #f3fcfb;

    body {

        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-top) 0%, var(--bg-bottom) 100%);
    }

    body {
      position: relative;
      overflow-x: auto;
      font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    }

    body::before,
    body::after {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;

    body::before {

    .page {

      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 24px 30px 28px;
    }

    }

item.text: I’m making one last tightening pass before I stop: slightly lighter heading mass and a slightly shorter right panel. That pushes the viewport fit further in the right direction without changing the new composition.

**Delivery**
1. Full file path: [akvatonus-2026-04-05_hero-desktop-02.html](C:\Users\User\OneDrive\Документы\New%20project\akvatonus.ru\akvatonus-2026-04-05_hero-desktop-02.html). Source used: the latest desktop hero file was [akvatonus-2026-04-04_hero-desktop-01.html](C:\Users\User\OneDrive\Документы\New%20project\akvatonus.ru\akvatonus-2026-04-04_hero-desktop-01.html).

2. What exactly changed:
   - Rebuilt the first screen into a shorter desktop silhouette: smaller page/shell padding, tighter left-column gaps, shorter right visual height, faster overall stack.
   - Replaced the dirty gray-green palette with a cleaner aqua/white/warm-sand scheme and stronger CTA contrast.
   - Shortened and lightened the H1 into a two-level 3-line structure, reduced weight, and shortened the supporting paragraph.
   - Compressed the benefit block into a tighter 2x2 commercial grid instead of the heavier previous panel feel.
   - Simplified the right side into one strong aqua media slot with minimal placeholder text, removing the nested technical placeholder architecture.

3. What was intentionally kept:
   - AkvaTonus meaning, hydromassage focus, honest local-business tone.
   - CTA text exactly `Записаться на сеанс`.
   - First-visit discount logic in the hero.
   - One media placeholder only on the right.
   - WhatsApp / Telegram contact path.
   - Mottor-ready popup structure and later popup section/script.

4. Whether popup still works:
   - Yes by preserved wiring: the CTA still uses `data-popup-target="#booking-popup"` and the same modal script is still in place.
   - I did not complete a live click test in a browser because headless Chrome/Edge was blocked by sandbox access errors.

5. Weakest remaining part:
   - The right side is still a placeholder surface. It is much cleaner now, but without a real controlled photo/video frame it cannot fully reach the commercial strength of the reference.

6. Next high-value step only:
   - Replace the abstract right placeholder with one real desktop visual cropped to this exact new silhouette.
